clips.start_words: I was with one spiritual guru
clips.caption:
Kevin Trudeau says he once filmed a show with a well-known spiritual guru who spent the whole segment teaching love, compassion, and understanding.

The moment the cameras stopped, that same man started screaming at his assistant because his car wasn't ready. At dinner afterward, he complained about everything on the table.

Trudeau's point: a lot of people teaching peace and love on camera are not peaceful or loving in real life. You can only give what you actually have inside you.

Does the person giving you advice actually live it, or just talk about it?

#kevintrudeau #authenticity #mindset #selfhelp #personaldevelopment #wisdom
clips.send: A student sends it to their life-coach friend, in anger at gurus who perform peace on camera and scream at staff the second it stops.
